architectural_determination: H6 can support a new independent evaluation only through its existing structured productive intake. This contract freezes the construction constraints but intentionally does not yet authorize case creation. First, representative non-held-out dry probes must demonstrate that the exact frozen intake form reaches the same productive H6 authority without translation or routing.
existing_authority: official conversation gateway -> productive GCDR intake
next_gate: HCPDQ-v2 H6 Entry-Path Equivalent Corpus — Dry-Probe Certification / Construction Authorization
next_required_decision: freeze case-count/difficulty design and certify representative entry-path dry probes before constructing any held-out case

rules.requirement: Every case must use the existing Decisión/Criterios/Evidencia intake.
Case identifiers and case content must be new and independently authored.
No consumed HCPDQ-v2 case may be reused, paraphrased or semantically rewritten.
Ground truth must be authored and frozen before any ROBY exposure.
Ground truth must not be visible to the evaluation subject or intake path.
The productive H6 entry path must be certified on representative dry probes.
Dry probes may verify routing only and must not reveal future held-out cases.
No benchmark-specific translation, semantic router or production change is allowed.
Corpus construction and ground-truth freeze do not authorize ROBY execution.
